messages:
nora (Billing): alert — Quantum Biologics (QB-404) card charge failed for INV-2025-11-902 ($13,760). customer emailed asking to split and is disputing 2 overage line items.
jess (AE): spoke to their controller (marco). admits they had a surge from an import job. wants a two-month split and a small credit for the disputed lines.
sam (Collections): we can do a split but need signed agreement + reconciliation accepted by billing. don't want to auto-waive charges until we validate.
jess (AE): sending them a proposed plan: 50/25/25 with first payment in 10 days. asking for their acceptance in reply.
finance-bot: Automated: retry attempt 1/3 for INV-2025-11-902 failed (card auth decline). next retry scheduled in 24h.
lila (Legal): if we accept split include a clause: missed payment => entire balance due; preserves termination rights. will DM a one-paragraph addendum to jess.
nora (Billing): add "reconciliation acknowledgement required before first installment" to the plan. also note credits > $1k need manager approval.
sam (Collections): once signed i'll set payment_plan:pending and mute dunning-bot. if ACH requested note verification delay (48-72h).
jess (AE): marco replied: prefers ACH, will sign and send reconciliation CSV today. asks if invoice due date can be extended to match first installment.
nora (Billing): we can extend due date in billing system once plan is active. hold dunning for now until plan flag is set.
dunning-bot: Automated: reminder scheduled for INV-2025-11-902 unless payment_plan flag set (next run 2155558400).
sam (Collections): thanks — jess drop the signed body here when you get it and i'll process.
jess (AE): will do, thx everyone.
